headline: Central Fronts Shift as Fierce Clashes Engulf the North
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, the central and northern fronts have seen intense combat and fresh territorial shifts. In Callahan’s Passage, Colonial forces punctured the Warden consolidation, clawing back an outpost amid twenty-five base exchanges over the past day centered on The Latch and Crumbling Post. To the south, Colonials consolidated complete control over Linn of Mercy’s eleven strongholds following renewed fighting at Lathair. Weathered Expanse persists as the conflict’s most murderous cauldron, logging four base transfers in the past two hours and over twelve thousand combined casualties in that same span as fighting roils Frostmarch and Shattered Advance. Stonecradle similarly endured severe attrition, shedding more than eighty-five hundred men in two hours while positions swapped hands around The Reach and Trammel Pool. Across Stlican Shelf, two rapid exchanges at Breaker Town and Fort Hoarfrost keep the sector heavily split. Meanwhile, though structural lines in Nevish Line and Mooring County have held steady through the morning, both regions continue to absorb heavy enlistments and fierce localized clashes.
